entities.name: AMF
entities.description: Access and Mobility Management Function that provides network slice configuration to the UE.

entities.name: Configured NSSAI
entities.description: Information element containing the network slice selection assistance information configured for the UE in the current PLMN or SNPN.

entities.name: UE
entities.description: User Equipment that receives the configured NSSAI from the AMF.

entities.name: UE neither registering nor registered for onboarding services in SNPN
entities.description: Condition that must be satisfied for the AMF to include the Configured NSSAI IE.

entities.name: AMF needs to provide new configured NSSAI
entities.description: Condition where the AMF requires to update the UE's configured NSSAI for the current PLMN or SNPN.

relations.description: AMF includes the Configured NSSAI IE when specific conditions are met.
The condition that AMF needs to provide a new configured NSSAI guards the inclusion of the IE.
The condition that UE is neither registering nor registered for onboarding services in SNPN guards the inclusion of the IE.
